 Print Offline applications will not be accepted after Nov 15 Shimla : Himachal Pradesh printing and stationery department will shift its name change and correction service in the e-Gazette to online mode from Nov 15, replacing the existing offline system. A department spokesperson said applicants would have to submit applications, requisite documents and prescribed fees through the single window clearance system. Offline applications will not be accepted after Nov 15. The spokesperson advised applicants to ensure that all details and documents were accurate, as the fee would be non-refundable. Common Service Centres will charge Rs 50 plus goods and services tax (GST) for providing the service, while the departmental publication fee will remain unchanged at Rs 120.
